name: 84109 · Salt Lake Cty, UT
findings: ZIP 84109 (Salt Lake Cty) has 108 nonprofit organizations. 50 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 84109 (Salt Lake Cty) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
